apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: frontend
  namespace: demo
  labels:
    app: frontend
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"
  annotations:
    repair.example.dev/source-path: deploy/demo/frontend.yaml
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: frontend
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: frontend
        app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"
    spec:
      nodeSelector:
        disktype: ssd
      containers:
        - name: frontend
          image: nginx:1.27-alpine
          ports:
            - containerPort: 80
          volumeMounts:
            - name: html
              mountPath: /usr/share/nginx/html/index.html
              subPath: index.html
              readOnly: true
            - name: nginx-conf
              mountPath: /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
              subPath: default.conf
              readOnly: true
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: 80
            periodSeconds: 5
          resources:
            requests:
              memory: 32Mi
              cpu: 25m
            limits:
              memory: 64Mi
              cpu: 250m
      volumes:
        - name: html
          configMap:
            name: frontend-html
        - name: nginx-conf
          configMap:
            name: frontend-nginx
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: frontend
  namespace: demo
  labels:
    app: frontend
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"
  annotations:
    repair.example.dev/source-path: deploy/demo/frontend.yaml
spec:
  type: NodePort
  selector:
    app: frontend
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: 80
      nodePort: 30080
